preview_en:
They may have the weight of momentum behind them, but Frosinone face a formidable test at the Stadio Benito Stirpe when they host high-flying Como .

Match News and Current Form

Frosinone’s encouraging start to the Serie A campaign continued with a hard-fought 1-1 draw away at Genoa last time out. Massimiliano Alvini’s side have now collected seven points from their opening four matches (W2, D1, L1), equalling their best-ever start to a top-flight season, but given that campaign ultimately ended in relegation, they won’t be taking anything for granted yet. Home form should help give them a solid foundation to ensure they avoid a repeat of history as Frosinone have won seven of their last nine competitive games at Stadio Benito Stirpe (D1, L1), with a 3-2 win against Venezia in their last such outing affording them a shot at securing consecutive Serie A home wins for the first time since late 2023.

Como enter this fixture riding a massive wave of momentum following a 2-1 victory over Parma which stretched their winning run to four matches. Cesc Fàbregas’ side have been one of the standout performers in the opening weeks of the season, entering this round third in Serie A (W3, D1) with ten points from a possible 12 and hitting the road could help in building further momentum. The Lariani have collected a league-high 30 Serie A away points in 2026 (W9, D3, L1) and travel here aiming to achieve three consecutive wins against sides from the Lazio region for the first time in their top-flight history.

Head-to-Head History

This will be the first top-flight meeting between the sides, with Frosinone winning four of their last five league matches against Como in Serie B and Serie C.

Hot Stats and Streaks

Frosinone have scored five of their seven league goals this season before the break.

Frosinone received at least two yellow cards in their last five matches.

Como conceded 2+ goals in just two of their last 18 competitive away games.

Como have scored a pre-round joint-league high six first-half goals.

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

With four competitive strikes already, Giorgi Kvernadze is proving to be Frosinone’s go-to man - he’s opened the scoring in eight of his last nine goalscoring appearances for the club. Como’s Nico Paz has picked up three assists in his last two outings, but could be a good pick to get on the scoresheet here given eight of his previous ten club goals arrived on the road.

Florian Grillitsch is a major doubt for Frosinone, whilst Jayden Addai remains out until after the international break for Como.

Betting Analysis

Given both sides’ tendency to be involved in early action, over 1.5 first-half goals looks an interesting angle.

Author: Tomáš Vlasák
